title: Puttering Puzzlefish
statement: A thumb-sized cuttlefish with accordion fins and flickering apricot freckles, the Puttering Puzzlefish spends its afternoons arranging smooth blue pebbles into spirals, then backing up to reconsider. Its tank is a little twilight courtyard of white sand and slate arches, with one warm shaft of light where it carries its favorite pebble to think.
